# Feature: Optional Email Address for Event Scanners

## Summary

Allow organizers to attach an **optional email address** to each event scanner, so that newly created scanners can automatically receive their **scanner link and access code via email**. Currently, organizers must manually share scanner codes with their door staff — this feature automates that handoff.

## Motivation

The current scanner workflow requires manual coordination:

1. Organizer creates a scanner in the dashboard (`ScannerManagement.tsx`)
2. Scanner gets a name and a 6-digit code
3. Organizer must **manually** tell the door person their code (text, DM, in person, etc.)
4. Door staff navigates to `/scan/[eventId]` and enters the code

This is friction-prone, especially for events with multiple door staff or last-minute scanner additions. An email notification would let organizers add a scanner and have the staff member immediately receive everything they need.

## Current State

### EventScanner Model (`prisma/schema.prisma`)

```prisma
model EventScanner {
  id        String         @id @default(cuid())
  eventId   String
  name      String
  code      String         // 6-digit code generated by generateScannerCode()
  isActive  Boolean        @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime       @updatedAt
  event     Event          @relation(fields: [eventId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  scanLogs  ScanLog[]
  shifts    ScannerShift[]

  @@unique([eventId, code])
  @@index([eventId])
  @@index([code])
}
```

**No email field exists.**

### Scanner Management UI (`src/components/dashboard/ScannerManagement.tsx`)

- Form with a single "Name" input to create a scanner
- Displays scanner code after creation for manual sharing
- Toggle to activate/deactivate scanners

### Scanner Auth (`src/lib/scanner-auth.ts`)

- `generateScannerCode()` creates a 6-digit code using `crypto.randomInt(100000, 1000000)`
- Scanner authenticates via JWT token at `/scan/[eventId]` by entering their code

### Scanner Creation API (`src/app/api/events/[eventId]/scanners/route.ts`)

- `POST` creates a new scanner with `name` and auto-generated `code`
- No email sending logic

## Proposed Changes

### 1. Data Model

Add an optional `email` field to `EventScanner`:

```prisma
model EventScanner {
  id        String         @id @default(cuid())
  eventId   String
  name      String
  code      String
  email     String?        // Optional email for sending scanner credentials
  isActive  Boolean        @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime       @updatedAt
  event     Event          @relation(fields: [eventId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  scanLogs  ScanLog[]
  shifts    ScannerShift[]

  @@unique([eventId, code])
  @@index([eventId])
  @@index([code])
}
```

### 2. Scanner Creation API Update

Update `POST /api/events/[eventId]/scanners/route.ts`:

```typescript
// Accept optional email in request body
const { name, email } = await req.json();

// Create scanner as before
const scanner = await prisma.eventScanner.create({
  data: {
    eventId,
    name,
    code: generateScannerCode(),
    email: email || null,
  },
  include: { event: true },
});

// If email provided, send credentials
if (email) {
  await sendScannerCredentialsEmail({
    to: email,
    scannerName: name,
    eventTitle: scanner.event.title,
    eventDate: scanner.event.startsAt,
    scannerCode: scanner.code,
    scanUrl: `${baseUrl}/scan/${eventId}`,
  });
}
```

### 3. Email Template

Create a scanner credentials email using the existing Resend integration (`src/lib/email.ts`):

**Subject:** `You've been added as a scanner for "[Event Title]"`

**Body:**

```
Hi [Scanner Name],

You've been added as door scanner for [Event Title] on [Event Date].

Here's what you need:

Scanner Link: [URL to /scan/eventId]
Your Code: [6-digit code]

Open the link on your phone, enter your code, and you're ready to scan tickets.

Tips:
- Make sure your phone's camera is working
- Keep your screen brightness up for QR scanning
- If you have issues, contact the event organizer

See you there!
```

The email should be well-designed using the existing email template patterns in the codebase. Consider including:

- Event flyer thumbnail if available
- Event venue and time
- A prominent CTA button linking directly to the scanner page
- The code displayed large and clearly

### 4. UI Changes

#### Scanner Creation Form (`ScannerManagement.tsx`)

Update the scanner creation form:

```
[Name]          ______________________
[Email]         ______________________ (optional)
                □ Send scanner link and code via email

[Create Scanner]
```

- Email field is optional — if left blank, behaves exactly as today
- Checkbox "Send scanner link and code via email" — auto-checked when email is entered
- After creation, show success message: _"Scanner created. Credentials sent to [email]."_ (or _"Scanner created."_ if no email)

#### Scanner List

In the scanner list, show the email if present:

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│ John (Door)                         │
│ Code: 482901                        │
│ john@example.com              ✉ ↻   │
│ Active ✓                            │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- ✉ icon indicates email was sent
- ↻ "Resend" button to re-send the credentials email (useful if staff lost the original)

### 5. Resend Credentials

Add a "Resend" action for scanners that have an email:

- `POST /api/events/[eventId]/scanners/[scannerId]/resend`
- Rate-limited: max 3 resends per scanner per hour
- Shows confirmation: _"Credentials re-sent to [email]"_

### 6. Email Update

Allow updating the email on an existing scanner:

- Editing the email field on an existing scanner should offer to send credentials to the new address
- If the email is removed, the scanner continues to work (code-based auth is unchanged)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `EventScanner` model has an optional `email` field
- [ ] Scanner creation form includes an optional email input
- [ ] When email is provided, credentials are automatically sent via Resend
- [ ] Email contains: scanner link, code, event details, and clear instructions
- [ ] Email template is well-designed and matches existing email patterns
- [ ] Scanner list shows email and "resend" button when email exists
- [ ] Resend endpoint works with rate limiting (max 3/hour)
- [ ] Scanners without email work exactly as before (no regression)
- [ ] Email field can be added/updated/removed on existing scanners
- [ ] i18n: Email subject and body translated for all supported locales (en, es-ES, es-LA, pt-BR)
- [ ] Input validation: email format validated on both client and server

## Technical Notes

- Use the existing Resend integration in `src/lib/email.ts` for sending
- Email sending should not block the API response — send asynchronously or use Resend's async mode
- Scanner code is security-sensitive — the email should note that the recipient should not share it
- Consider adding `emailSentAt` timestamp field to track when credentials were last sent
- The scanner link should be a full absolute URL (not relative) for email clients
- Validate email format server-side before attempting to send

## Edge Cases

- Organizer enters an invalid email → Show validation error, don't create scanner until fixed or email removed
- Email delivery fails → Scanner is still created (code works regardless), show warning to organizer
- Multiple scanners with same email → Allowed (same person scanning multiple events)
- Scanner deactivated after email sent → Code stops working; no email sent about deactivation (organizer handles this)

## Labels

`feature`, `scanners`, `medium-priority`
